So... I just wanna reflect rn cuz man is this tiring like ive spend 4 hours on the front part of the head itself which is kinda wild and i dont think ill be able to motorize the saw right away so i gotta figure that out.. at this point im leaning towards making it the motorized stuff with eva foam.
